description: Find all widgets matching a given type across one or more dashboards.

widget_type.description: The widget type to match (for example ``"BloX"``, ``"chart"``, ``"pivot"``). Comparison is case-sensitive.

dashboards.description: One or more dashboard IDs or titles to search. A bare string is treated as a single-item list. When ``None`` (default), all dashboards on the instance are searched.

admin_access.description: When ``True`` (default), enumerates all dashboards on the instance via the admin endpoint and fetches widgets using ``adminAccess=true``, so dashboards owned by other users are included. When ``False``, only dashboards visible to the API token user are scanned.

max_results.description: Stop after collecting this many matching widgets. ``None`` (default) means no limit.

examples.user_query: Find all BloX widgets across all dashboards visible to the API token user.
examples.notes: This call searches for all widgets of type 'BloX' in dashboards accessible to the API token user, excluding dashboards owned by other users.

examples.user_query: Which dashboards contain pivot widgets? Limit the results to 10 matches.
examples.notes: This call searches for up to 10 widgets of type 'pivot' across all dashboards on the instance.

examples.user_query: Search for chart widgets in dashboards with IDs 'dash123' and 'dash456'.
examples.notes: This call looks for widgets of type 'chart' specifically in the dashboards with IDs 'dash123' and 'dash456'.

description: Retrieve a single widget by its dashboard and widget IDs.

dashboard_id.description: The ``oid`` of the dashboard that contains the widget.

widget_id.description: The ``oid`` of the widget to retrieve.

admin_access.description: When ``True`` (default), appends ``?adminAccess=true`` to the request, allowing access to dashboards the API token user does not own. Some Sisense versions reject the ``adminAccess`` query parameter with HTTP 422 (strict query-schema validation); the request is then retried automatically without it.

examples.user_query: Retrieve the widget with ID 'widget123' from the dashboard 'dashboard456', ensuring admin access.
examples.notes: This call retrieves the specified widget from the given dashboard, using admin access to bypass ownership restrictions if necessary.

examples.user_query: What is the configuration of the widget with ID 'widget789' in dashboard 'dashboard101'?
examples.notes: This call fetches the widget object from the specified dashboard without admin access, suitable for cases where the user owns the dashboard.

examples.user_query: Can you fetch the widget 'widget555' from the dashboard 'dashboard999'?
examples.notes: This call retrieves the widget from the specified dashboard without using admin access, ensuring compatibility with strict query-schema validation in some Sisense versions.

description: Write updated widget data back to Sisense.

dashboard_id.description: The ``oid`` of the dashboard that contains the widget.

widget_id.description: The ``oid`` of the widget to update.

widget_data.description: The full widget payload with the desired changes applied. Server-managed fields are removed automatically before the PUT request.

examples.user_query: Update the widget with ID 'widget123' in dashboard 'dashboard456' to reflect the new data provided.
examples.notes: This call updates the specified widget in the given dashboard with new data and styling. Use this when you need to modify an existing widget's content or appearance.

examples.user_query: How can I update the widget 'widget789' in dashboard 'dashboard123' to show the latest revenue data?
examples.notes: This example demonstrates how to update a widget to display new revenue data for the first quarter. Useful for keeping dashboards up-to-date with the latest metrics.

examples.user_query: Can I modify the widget 'widget456' in dashboard 'dashboard789' to include updated product performance data?
examples.notes: This call updates a table widget to reflect new product performance data. Ideal for presenting detailed tabular insights in a dashboard.
